say:2:1741115001:1.text: Gwyneth, you've been staring at me for ten minutes!
say:2:1741115001:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝，你已经盯着我看了十分钟了！

say:3:1741115002:1.text: I have? Sorry, little fox. That was rude of me...
say:3:1741115002:1.source_cn: 哎，是吗？抱歉，小狐狸，是我失礼了……

say:4:1741115003:1.text: I was just being careful. We still barely know you, and it's my job to keep watch.
say:4:1741115003:1.source_cn: 我的本意只是在观察你的行为模式，毕竟你来历不明，作为守...

say:5:1741115004:1.text: Ouch. Somehow that hurts even more than the staring. My poor fox heart...
say:5:1741115004:1.source_cn: 喂喂喂！这个回答可比直接盯着我看更伤人……不对，更伤狐啊！

say:6:1741115005:1.text: Your fur looked so soft, your ears all pointy, and your tail... so fluffy, like a cloud. I just couldn't help wondering what it'd feel like to touch it.
say:6:1741115005:1.source_cn: 小狐狸的毛色看起来很柔顺，耳朵尖尖的，尾巴蓬松得像云朵...

say:7:1741115006:1.text: And before I knew it, I got a little carried away...
say:7:1741115006:1.source_cn: 我看着看着，就不由自主地沉浸其中了……

say:8:1741115007:1.text: Hmph. Well, when you put it like that, I suppose I can forgive you.
say:8:1741115007:1.source_cn: 哼哼，你这样一说，倒是让我生气不起来了。

choice_prompt:9:1741115007.text: Hmph. Well, when you put it like that, I suppose I can forgive you.
choice_prompt:9:1741115007.source_cn: 哼哼，你这样一说，倒是让我生气不起来了。

say:10:1741115008:1.text: Wait... you think someone could use this against me?
say:10:1741115008:1.source_cn: 哎？您的意思是这会成为我的弱点吗？
say:10:1741115008:1.male: Wait... you think someone could use this against me?
say:10:1741115008:1.female: Wait... you think someone could use this against me?

say:11:1741115009:1.text: That is possible. If someone knew I liked cute things, they could use them to distract me. A knight can't afford that kind of weakness.
say:11:1741115009:1.source_cn: 的确，别有用心之人有可能会利用我喜爱的事物诱惑于我。对...
say:11:1741115009:1.male: That is possible. If someone knew I liked cute things, they could use them to distract me. A knight can't afford that kind of weakness.
say:11:1741115009:1.female: That is possible. If someone knew I liked cute things, they could use them to distract me. A knight can't afford that kind of weakness.

say:13:1741115010:1.text: Exposure training? How does that work?
say:13:1741115010:1.source_cn: 脱敏治疗？是怎样的疗法？
say:13:1741115010:1.male: Exposure training? How does that work?
say:13:1741115010:1.female: Exposure training? How does that work?

choice_prompt:14:1741115010.text: Exposure training? How does that work?
choice_prompt:14:1741115010.source_cn: 脱敏治疗？是怎样的疗法？
choice_prompt:14:1741115010.male: Exposure training? How does that work?
choice_prompt:14:1741115010.female: Exposure training? How does that work?

say:15:1741115012:1.text: Pet him? Just like that? Is that really okay?
say:15:1741115012:1.source_cn: 摸……就这样摸小狐狸的话，不合规矩吧？
say:15:1741115012:1.male: Pet him? Just like that? Is that really okay?
say:15:1741115012:1.female: Pet him? Just like that? Is that really okay?

say:16:1741115013:1.text: It's okay if I say it's okay. Bring me a snack, and I'll allow one quick touch of the tail.
say:16:1741115013:1.source_cn: 其实，可以哦。只要给点好吃的，本狐可以勉为其难让你摸一...

say:17:1741115014:1.text: Make it a big meal, and I might even let you touch the ears!
say:17:1741115014:1.source_cn: 如果能享用一顿大餐的话，让你摸摸耳朵也不是不行！

say:18:1741115015:1.text: Really? I do have some dried meat with me...
say:18:1741115015:1.source_cn: 真的吗？我这里刚好有一块肉干……

say:19:1741115016:1.text: Or... little fox, would you like to come with me to the garden restaurant?
say:19:1741115016:1.source_cn: 或许，小狐狸，我可以邀请你去花园餐厅享用美食吗？

choice:14:0:1.text: For example, pet this fox more often.
choice:14:0:1.male: For example, pet this fox more often.
choice:14:0:1.female: For example, pet this fox more often.

choice:14:1:2.text: Pet the fox enough, and it won't be such a big deal anymore.
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 摸习惯了就不会觉得可爱了
choice:14:1:2.male: Pet the fox enough, and it won't be such a big deal anymore.
choice:14:1:2.female: Pet the fox enough, and it won't be such a big deal anymore.

say:21:1741115011:1.source_cn: 依阁下之言，要怎样进行练习呢？

choice:12:1:2.text: You should get used to it through practice.
choice:12:1:2.male: You should get used to it through practice.
choice:12:1:2.female: You should get used to it through practice.
